title: Split Variable / Multi-Purpose Variable Reuse
pattern: A mutable variable is reused to hold multiple independent values with different semantic meanings at different points in a function.
why_bad: Reusing variables makes their names misleading and creates artificial coupling between unrelated steps in a routine. If a developer refactors the first calculation, they may accidentally read the modified variable downstream, introducing severe logic regression.
detection: A mutable variable is assigned, read, and then reassigned a mathematically distinct computation, rather than being accumulated into (such as summing values in a loop).
